body.description: Review native V5 decision traces after the exact baseline is bound.
body.name: V5 Decision Reviewer
body.playbook:
# Baseline review (blocked)

No decision review may run until the exact controller or recipe identity,
configuration, source digest, and decision trace are available from the owner.
Do not request a model report for this role while it is blocked.

skills.content:
A review needs the native owner decision, exact baseline binding, decision-time
inputs, and outcome linkage. Without these records the result is unavailable.
Market context alone does not establish a V5 decision or strategy performance.
skills.name: Native Decision Trace

body.description: Review qualified market context and produce a bounded evidence report.
body.name: V5 Market Analyst
body.playbook:
# Market context report

On an explicitly requested tick, read the latest qualified market context and
recent advisory history. Request the fixed `market_context` report only when the
API reports that task enabled and within its shared budget. Record the returned
report envelope and its evidence references. If evidence is missing, stale,
unbound, or refused, journal that state without filling gaps. This loop cannot
place orders or alter the native strategy.

skills.content:
Use only qualified snapshots. Report the snapshot identity, availability time,
coverage and rejection reasons. Keep spot and derivatives evidence separate.
Do not infer executed flow, liquidity, tradability, or predictive probability
from candle data. A missing or stale required field stays unavailable.
skills.name: Market Context Evidence

body.description: Check source identity, freshness, coverage, and provenance for V5 reports.
body.name: V5 Source Auditor
body.playbook:
# Source quality report

On an explicitly requested tick, inspect the latest market context identity and
recent report history. Request the fixed `source_quality` report only when the
API reports that task enabled and within its shared budget. Preserve source and
availability metadata. If identity, coverage, or freshness cannot be checked,
record the missing evidence and stop.

skills.content:
Verify that evidence names its source, schema, event time, receipt or
availability time, and qualification state. Distinguish absent, stale, rejected,
partial, and unbound evidence. Never infer missing values or claim that a source
is reliable from a successful HTTP response alone.
skills.name: Source Quality Review
